subject: Time limit exceeded on all test cases
issue: My solution works perfectly on the sample inputs but every hidden test case gets TLE. My algorithm should be O(n log n). Any advice?
response: When your HackerRank solution receives a "Time Limit Exceeded" (TLE) error, it indicates that your code exceeded the allowed execution time, typically 2-10 seconds, for at least one test case. While your solution may pass sample inputs, hidden test cases are often designed to test edge cases and performance with larger inputs. To address TLE, first, carefully review your algorithm's complexity to ensure it genuinely performs at O(n log n) or better, especially under large input conditions. Consider whether your solution might be doing repeated work that could be optimized using techniques like memoization or dynamic programming. Additionally, inefficient input/output operations, such as numerous print statements in Python, can contribute to timeouts; using efficient I/O methods (e.g., `sys.stdout.write` in Python) can help. Other potential causes for TLE include infinite loops or excessive memory allocation that triggers frequent garbage collection. Check for these issues in your code, particularly when dealing with the types of challenging inputs that hidden test cases are designed to provide.
justification: The ticket describes a 'Time Limit Exceeded' issue. The response directly addresses this by explaining TLE, its common causes (complexity, repeated work, I/O inefficiency, infinite loops, memory), and suggests solutions, all based on the provided documentation regarding test cases and common issues.
